001: Excuse me, where is the station?
If you go straight down this road, it's on the right side.
How long does it take on foot?
I think it takes about ten minutes.
002: Does this bus go to Shinjuku?
No, this bus doesn't go there. It's from platform number three next door.
Oh, I see. I got on at the wrong platform.
It's okay. That bus over there will come soon.
That's a relief. Thank you very much.
003: Excuse me, I don't know how to buy a ticket.
You can buy one at that ticket machine over there. First, insert your money.
Yes, it's fine. Please press the button for your destination.
004: Does this train stop at Tokyo Station?
Yes, it does. It's the next station.
What time will we arrive at the next station?
I think we'll arrive around eleven fifteen.
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
005: Excuse me, may I look at this route map?
Yes, go ahead. Where do you want to go?
I want to go to Shibuya. How should I get there?
Take this green line, and transfer at the fourth stop.
I see. Got it. Thank you.
006: Go out the east exit of the station, and it's immediately on the left.
That's the line of cars over there, right?
That's right. It's not too crowded right now, so you can get one right away.
Go ahead. Have a good one.
007: Is this train a rapid train?
No, this is a local train that stops at every station.
Which track does the rapid train leave from?
It leaves from track number four across the way. It'll be here in about five minutes.
Good luck. Just don't run, okay?
008: Excuse me, how far can I use this ticket?
Up to Kichijoji. Beyond that, you'll need a different ticket.
Oh, I see. I didn't know that.
If you're going further, you can pay the difference at the ticket gate.
009: Excuse me, does this bus go to the airport?
Yes, it does. However, it gets crowded at this time of day.
I see. How long does it take?
You should plan for about an hour.
Got it. I hope I'll make it in time.
Don't worry. The next bus will be here soon.
010: Excuse me, may I get off here?
Oh, I'm sorry. You can't get off here.
This bus only has a door at the front, so please get off at the next stop.
I see. Got it. Thank you.
I'm sorry about that. The next stop is coming right up.
